# Generated media fixtures

These short fixtures contain a generated 440 Hz sine wave and no third-party
recording. They are test data, not examples of production encoding quality.

- FLAC, MP3, Vorbis, Opus, Speex, MP4 AAC, MP4 ALAC, ADTS AAC, WAV, AIFF, and
  WavPack were generated with FFmpeg 8.1.2.
- Monkey's Audio was encoded from the same generated WAV with `mac` 12.95.
- Musepack was encoded from the same generated WAV with `mpcenc` r475.

The fixture names are stable inputs to the versioned capability-matrix tests.
